claims.statement: Within the declared Laurent ansatz, Bach-flatness is equivalent to c2=c3=0 and w^2+3*u*gamma=1.
On the full Laurent locus the Einstein sheet requires gamma=0 and w=1; gamma=0 alone is sufficient only on the Mannheim-Kazanas component through w=1.
The bare chart-normalized Iyer-Wald one-form is radially constant but non-closed on the static parameter family.
Residual basicness forces N=u*f(J); for N=u the corrected charge is exact with the displayed Hamiltonian.
The displayed Hamiltonian, Wald entropy, and signed temperature obey dH=T_h*dS_h at every simple horizon simultaneously.
Arbitrary linear spherical Weyl and diffeomorphism directions have zero corrected charge; conformal directions also have zero entropy variation and zero corrected pairing with parameter modes.

does_not_establish: a preferred physical mass or asymptotic clock
a nonlinear or second-order physical-process first law
the bilinear radiative symplectic flux matrix
stability, quasinormal ringing, Hawking radiation, or a quantum theorem
